senses.gloss: हंस m. (this word is curiously derived by native philologists; भवेद् वर्णागमाद् हंसः, i.e. it is derived from हस् by the insertion of a nasal.) 1. A goose, a swan, a flamingo, हिरण्मयं हंसमबोधि नैषधः Na.i.117, Megh.i.23, 57, R.xvii.25, iii.10, v.12, xii.62; (the description of this bird as found in Sanskrit poetry is rather poetical than real; swans are considered to fly to the Mānasa lake when monsoon sets in; they are also represented as being the vehicle of Brahman (m.); there is a convention among poets that this bird is gifted with the power of separating milk from water; thus Bhartṛhari says- अम्भोजिनीवननिवासविलासमेव हंसस्य हंति नितरां कुपितो विधाता । नत्वस्य दुग्धजलभेदविधौ प्रसिद्धां वैदग्ध्यकीर्तिमपहर्तुमसौ समर्थः, See also Bh.V.i.13; 2. the supreme soul, Brahman (n.); 3. the jīvātman or individual soul; 4. the sun; 5. an unambitious monarch; 6. Viṣṇu; 7. Śiva; 8. an ascetic of a particular order; 9. a preceptor; 10. free from envy or malice.
हंस-अधिरूढा f. an epithet of Sarasvatī.
हंस-अभिख्य n. silver.
हंस-कांता f. a female goose.
हंस-कीलक m. a particular form of sexual union.
हंस-गति a. having a swan’s gait.
हंस-गद्गदा f. sweetly speaking woman.
हंस-गामिनी f. 1. a woman having a graceful gait, M.iii.10; 2. an epithet of Brāhmaṇī.
हंस-तूल m. the soft feathers of a goose.
हंस-दाहन n. aloe-wood.
हंस-नाद m. the cackling of a goose.
हंस-नादिनी f. woman having a slender waist, large hips, the gait of an elephant and the voice of a cuckoo, (गजेंद्रगमना तन्वी कोकिलालापसंयुता । नितंबे गुर्विणी या स्यात् सा स्मृता हंसनादिनी).
हंस-माला f. 1. a flight of wild geese, K.S.i.30; 2. a kind of metre.
हंस-युवन् m. a young goose or swan.
हंस-रथ, -वाहन m. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
हंस-रथ, -वाहन m. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
हंस-राज m. a king of geese.
हंस-लोहक n. brass.
हंस-श्रेणी f. a row of geese.

हंसक m. 1. A goose, a flamingo; 2. an ornament for the ankles, सरित इव सविभ्रमश्रयातप्रणदितहंसकभूषणा विरेजुः Sis.vii.23 (where the word is used in both the senses).(हंसक may be used in all the senses of हंस.)
हंसिका f. A female goose.
हंसिका f. A female goose.
हंहो (I) ind. 1. A vocative particle corresponding to ‘ho,’ ‘hollo,’ हंहो चिन्मयचित्तचंद्रमणयः Ch.L.i.2.

हंहो (II) ind. A particle expressing haughtiness, contempt or interrogation.(In drama, it is found used as a form of address in speeches assigned to characters of the middling class, e.g. हंहो ब्बह्मण कस्य एदं गेहम् Mud.i.)
हंजा ind. A vocative particle used in addressing a female attendant or maidservant, हंजे तरलिए उवणेहि मे अग्घभाअणम् Ve.ii., (हंडे हंजे हलाह्वाने नीचां चेटीं सखीं प्रति Am.i.7.15).
हंजा ind. A vocative particle used in addressing a female attendant or maidservant, हंजे तरलिए उवणेहि मे अग्घभाअणम् Ve.ii., (हंडे हंजे हलाह्वाने नीचां चेटीं सखीं प्रति Am.i.7.15).
हंडा (I) ind. A vocative particle used in addressing a female of inferior rank (in the drama).
हंडा (II) f. A large earthen pot.
हंडिका f. An earthen pot.
हंडिका f. An earthen pot.
हंडे ind. See हंडा (I).

हन् vt. 2P (pp. हन; pres. हन्ति; pass. हन्यते; desid. जिघांसति; caus. घातयति-ते) 1. To strike, to beat, इति गदितवती रुषा जघान कांतमन्या सममसितांबुरुहेण चक्षुषा च Sis.vii.56; 2. to strike down, to kill, to destroy, Rt.i.16, Bt.vi.51, i.22, v.40, xv.17; 3. to injure, to hurt, to afflict; 4. to overcome, to overthrow, to conquer, e.g. विघ्नैः सहस्रगुणितैरपि हन्यमानाः; 5. to remove, to take away, अम्भोजिनीवननिवासविलासमेव हंसस्य हंति नितरां कुपितो विधाता Bhartr.ii.18; 6. to obstruct; 7. to multiply (in math.); 8. to go, to move; (not generally used in this sense in classical literature; in a few places where it is found so used, poeticians have held the use to be faulty; the following stanza is instanced in K.Pr.- तीर्थांतरेषु स्नानेन समुपार्जितसत्कृतिः । सुरस्रोतस्विनीमेश्च हन्ति (i.e. गच्छति) संप्रति सादरम् vii.With अंतर्-, to strike in the middle.With अप-, 1. to destroy, to ward off, to repel; 2. to lessen, न च खलु तयोर्ज्ञाने शक्तिं करोत्यपहंति वा Ut.ii.With अभि-, 1. to strike, to beat, M.xi.206, R.xvi.78; 2. to beat or blow (as an instrument of music), Bg.i.13; 3. to injure, to inflict, to inflict injury on.With अव-, 1. to strike, to hit; 2. to thresh, to winnow (as corn).With आ-, (Atm.) 1. to strike at, to hit, to beat, आजघ्ने विषमविलोचनस्य वक्षः Kir.xvii.63, Bt.v.102, R.xii.77, K.S.iv.25; 2. to beat (as a drum), Bt.i.27, xvii.7.With उद्-, 1. to raise up, to elevate; 2. to become haughty or vain.With उप-, 1. to kill, to destroy; 2. to vex, to injure, to disturb, ग्रामश्चौरैरयमुपहतः पांथ निद्रां जहीहि Sr.T.12, मलोपहतप्रसादे (दर्पणतले) Sak.vii., Kir.v.48, K.S.v.76.With नि-, 1. to strike, तानेव सामर्षतया निजघ्नुः R.vii.44; 2. to beat (as a drum), Bt.xiv.2; 3. to kill, to destroy, Bt.ii.34, vi.101, R.xi.71; 4. to frustrate, to render void; 5. to neglect, to disregard; 6. to cure (as a disease).With परा-, 1. to strike, to strike down or back, विवृत्तपाठीनपराहतं पयः Kir.iv.5; 2. to assail, e.g. कटाक्षपराहतं वदनपंकजम्; 3. to overthrow, to repulse, to repel, to drive back, e.g. दैवं मत्पौरुषपराहतम्.With प्र-, 1. to kill, to slay, प्राघानिषत रक्षांसि येनाप्तानि वने मम । न प्रहण्मः कथं पापं वद पूर्वापकारिणम् Bt.ix.102; 2. to beat (as a drum), R.xix.14, Megh.ii.1; 3. to strike, to beat.With प्रति-, 1. to strike back, to strike in return, to ward off, to keep off, तं वाहनादवनतोत्तरकायमीषद्विध्यंतमुद्धृतसटाः प्रतिहंतुमीषुः R.ix.60; 2. to drive back, to repel; 3. to oppose, to resist, इत्थं नामात्कृतमप्रतिहतं चापलं दहति Sak.v., जंबूकुंजप्रतिहतरयं तोयमादाय गच्छेः Megh.i.20; 4. to remove.With वि-, 1. to strike, to strike violently; 2. to oppose, to impede, to resist, e.g. विघ्नंति रक्षांसि वने क्रतूंश्च Bt.i.19; 3. to reject, to refuse, to deny, R.ii.58; 4. to kill, to destroy, to destroy utterly, Kir.i.33, v.17.With सम्-, 1. to join or unite closely, संहतास्तु हरंतीमे जालं मम विहंगमाः Hit.i.; 2. to accumulate, to collect; 3. to destroy, to kill; 4. to contract, to diminish.
हन् a. (used only at the end of compounds, as in पितृहन्, मातृहन्, आचार्यहन्, ब्राह्मणहन्) Killing, slaying, वाचा हरिं वृत्रहणं स्मितेन K.S.vii.46.
हन m. Killing, slaying.
हान n. 1. The act of abandoning, हिमहानकृता न कृता क्वचन Bt.x.5; 2. prowess, valour.
हनन n. 1. The act of striking or killing; 2. the act of injuring; 3. multiplication (in math.).
हनु(नू) (I) m.f. The chin.
हनु(नू) (II) f. 1.Disease, sickness; 2. a kind of perfume; 3. a prostitute, a wanton woman.
हनु(नू) (I) m.f. The chin.
हनु(नू) (II) f. 1.Disease, sickness; 2. a kind of perfume; 3. a prostitute, a wanton woman.
हनु(नू)-मत् m. name of a monkey-chief. (See App. II.)
हनु(नू)-मत् m. name of a monkey-chief. (See App. II.)
हनु(नू)-मूल n. the root of the chin.
हनु(नू)-मूल n. the root of the chin.
हनूष m. A demon.

हंत ind. A particle implying- (1) grief (‘ah, alas’), हंतैकस्मित् क्वचिदपि न ते चंडि सादृश्यमस्ति Megh.ii.41, or Ut.i.; (2) compassion, पुत्रक हंत ते धानाकाः G.M.; (3) flurry or haste, हंत प्रवृत्तं संगीतकम् Mal.i.; (4) joy, हंत जातमस्मद्बलानामवलंबनम् Ve.iv.; (5) surprise.(This word is sometimes used as an inceptive particle.)
हंत-उक्ति f. saying alas, i.e. tenderness, compassion.
हंत-कार m. 1. the exclamation hanta; 2. an offering to be presented to a guest, भूरियं हंतकारः K.Pr.vii.
हंतृ (I) a. (f. त्री) 1. Who or what strikes or kills, K.S.ii.20; 2. one who destroys or removes.
हंतृ (II) m. A thief, a robber.
हंतृ (I) a. (f. त्री) 1. Who or what strikes or kills, K.S.ii.20; 2. one who destroys or removes.
हंबा(भा) f. The lowing of cattle.
हंबा(भा) f. The lowing of cattle.
हंबा(भा)-रव m. lowing of kine.
हंबा(भा)-रव m. lowing of kine.
हांगर m. A large fish.

हानि f. 1. Decrease, deficiency, प्रसादे सर्वदुःखानां हानिरस्योपजायये Bg.ii.66, Yaj.ii.207; 2. loss, damage, यद्यपि न कापि हानिः परकीयां चरति रासभे द्राक्षाम् Ud.; 3. abandonment, relinquishment, neglet.
